title: Pure Light and Darkness Ritual
summary: The Light and Darkness Ritual cards with Ragged Records of Rites, Black Skull Dragon, and generic staples, built to play the page's combo lines. The deck focuses on summoning Level 8 Ritual bosses that remain unaffected by opponent monster effects unless targeted, backed by continuous GY recursion.

summary.title: Starters & Searchers
points: Black Chaos: Shuffles a Spellcaster or Warrior Ritual Monster from hand or GY into the Deck to Special Summon itself, discards itself to place Mind Shuffle from the Deck or GY face-up, and once per turn banishes two cards the opponent controls.

Celtic Mystic: On summon reveals your hand, and if it holds a card that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual, draws three and discards two; it can also tribute itself to Special Summon one of the Ritual bosses from the hand.

Griffoh (Limited): Discards itself to Set a Quick-Play Spell or Trap that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual directly from Deck with permission to activate it that turn, and counts as the entire Level 8 Ritual tribute.
Ragged Records of Rites: Reveals Light and Darkness Ritual from the hand or Deck to add a monster that mentions it from Deck to hand.

Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity: Discards a Quick-Play Spell or Ritual Spell to Special Summon itself, then Sets a Spell or Trap that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual from the Deck or GY, covering for the single Griffoh.

summary.title: Opening: Griffoh and Ritual Setup
steps: Discard Griffoh (or Special Summon Black Skull Dragon) to Set Mind Shuffle or Chaos Magical Hats directly from your Deck.
Activate Mind Shuffle to add Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness or Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos from Deck to hand.
Activate Light and Darkness Ritual, banishing Griffoh from the GY as the entire Tribute (or Tributing or banishing other monsters) to Ritual Summon your Level 8 Ritual boss.
Later, use Light and Darkness Ritual's GY effect to add itself and another card that mentions it back to the hand.

summary.title: Bosses & Disruption
points: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness: Banishes a card the opponent controls when Special Summoned, cannot be destroyed by battle, attacks twice, and is unaffected by non-targeting activated effects.
Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos: Recovers a Spell from the GY on summon, banishes an opponent's card face-down once per turn, and protects your Spells and Traps from destruction.
Skull Archfiend of Chaos: Summons itself by recycling three banished or GY cards, and when sent to the GY, sends Light and Darkness Ritual to search a Ritual Monster.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Light and Darkness Ritual: Dedicated Ritual Spell that can tribute from hand/field or banish materials from the GY, returning itself and another card to hand each turn.
Mind Shuffle: Searches monsters mentioning the Ritual Spell, and during the opponent's turn, quick-tags a Level 7 or higher monster on field for another from your hand or Deck.
Spell Shattering Sword: Destroys all face-up Spells your opponent controls, or targets an opponent's monster to reduce its ATK to 0 and negate its effects.
Chaos Magical Hats and Chaos Mystic Box: Defensive Quick-Play Spells that redirect opponent targeting effects, generate board presence, and destroy opposing cards.

allow.Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Uni: Beyond the Brave support: discards a Quick-Play or Ritual Spell to summon itself and Sets a Spell/Trap that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual.
